_note: Industry, street, ownership, moat, critiques and gaps for the Q1FY27 initiation. Only sources published on or before 30-Sep-2026; later facts go to updates/later-facts.json.

industry.point: India's phosphatic market is ~24 mt a year: DAP ~10 mt and NPK complexes ~14 mt, of which NPK 20:20:0:13 (Paradeep's lead grade) is 6-7 mt. Farmer-level phosphatic sales grew ~1% in Q1FY27.
FY26: industry NPK (standalone) −1%, NPK+TSP +1.6%; Paradeep +10% and +15%. Paradeep's NPK 20:20:0:13 volume 1.45 mt (+9%).

The Middle East crisis: 70-75% of world sulphur and ammonia trade passes the Strait of Hormuz; sulphur ~$850/t in Q1FY27 and $1,000+ by end-July (vs ~$350/t a year earlier); ammonia ~$850/t (vs ~$550/t); phosphoric acid contract $1,700/t P2O5 for Jul-Sep 2026 (+25%); DAP imports $915-935/t CFR in Aug-2026.
Q1FY27 industry DAP+NPK production fell 21% and imports 38% because Kharif NBS rates (+~10%) did not cover the cost jump (Coromandel's Q1FY27 call).

Policy: Kharif 2026 NBS ₹41,534 cr (N ₹47.32, P ₹52.76, S ₹3.16 per kg; +~10%); DAP MRP held at ₹1,350 a bag with ₹3,500/t extra support and import-price compensation (reported extended through rabi); rabi 2026-27 rates not announced by 30-Sep-2026; FY27 budget for NBS + urea ₹1,70,799 cr.

Urea: National Investment Policy for Urea-2026 approved 15-Jul-2026 (8-9 new gas-based plants); energy norms tightened on 30-Jul-2026 (CRISIL: legacy plant profit −25% to ~₹1,250/t); Paradeep expects +₹1,500/t at Goa and −₹700-800/t at Mangalore.
2026 south-west monsoon 87% of the long-period average; south peninsula 76%, east & north-east 74% (Paradeep sells most in the east, south and west).
Granulation additions FY26-28 by peers ~1.5 mt (Coromandel 0.75 mt, RCF, Madhya Bharat) vs Paradeep's planned ~1.3 mt (1.0 mt greenfield + ~0.3 mt debottlenecking).

brokers.thesis: Q1 beat on low-cost inventory; costs to weigh on Q2 unless subsidy rises; debottlenecking from H2FY27 and full acid integration by FY29; FY27E/FY28E EPS ₹9.6 / ₹12.6

Cut FY27E EBITDA ~27% as sulphur and ammonia rose 80-100%; multiple cut from 11.5x for higher leverage (net debt ~1x equity, ~3x EBITDA); expansions drive EBITDA from FY29 (latest note found; before Q1FY27)

consensus.note: No dated FY27-28 consensus published between the Q1FY27 results and 30-Sep-2026 was found. Aggregators seen in Nov-2026 (Trendlyne, StockAnalysis: 3-4 analysts, targets ₹133-170) are not dated to 30-Sep and are not used.

street.split: Two brokers with published calls by 30-Sep-2026: Prabhudas Lilladher (Accumulate, ₹158, 13x FY28E P/E, after Q1FY27) and Elara Capital (Buy, ₹156, 8x FY28E EV/EBITDA, May-2026). No Sell found. The latest method is P/E on FY28E.

moat.evidence: OCP group supplied ~₹8,200 cr of rock, acid, TSP and DAP in FY26 (about half of purchases); no rock or acid shortage in the 2026 crisis; 10-year rock agreement, OCP supplies Paradeep exclusively in India (plant visit).
Captive berth and 3.4 km conveyor at Paradeep port, ammonia and acid pipelines; Goa near Mormugao, Mangalore on its port; product lines switch in 4-5 hours.

Paradeep 'almost fully integrated' in phosphoric acid (0.5 mt) and sulphuric acid (~2 mt); Goa and Mangalore buy acid; full integration only after the ₹3,600 cr programme (FY29-30). Coromandel already makes ~60% of its acid.
Among the top 2-3 NPK sellers (NPK 20:20:0:13 1.45 mt); Jai Kisaan Navratna/Mangala brands; ~₹250-300 a bag premium claimed (plant visit) but no disclosed proof in margins.
Subsidy (NBS) and the DAP MRP (₹1,350 a bag) set the economics; NPK price rises are capped by farmer demand (₹1,000 a bag gap to DAP in Q1FY27).
Net debt ~₹6,500 cr at Mar-2026 (~3x EBITDA, ~1x equity) with ₹3,600 cr of capex ahead; the government owed ₹4,600 cr at Jun-2026. Coromandel and Chambal are net cash.
4.21 mt sold in FY26, second-largest private phosphatic maker; 3.7 mt granulation (4.0 mt after debottlenecking) vs IFFCO and Coromandel.

critiques.argument: Subsidy rates lag raw-material costs: Kharif 2026 NBS rose ~10% while sulphur and ammonia rose 80-100%; the gain from own acid shrinks as sulphur rises.
Q1FY27's ~₹7,300/t EBITDA was flattered by low-cost opening stock; management itself guides ~₹5,000/t for the year.
Leverage: net debt near 1x equity and 3x EBITDA before the ₹3,600 cr programme; Elara cut its multiple from 11.5x to 8x EV/EBITDA for this reason.
The bull case: full acid integration (+30-35% on ₹5,000/t), 1.3 mt of new granulation and MCFL synergies take EBITDA towards ₹7,000/t and volumes towards 5 mt by FY29-30.
Governance: 15% of promoter shares were pledged in Jun-2026 (ZACL 41% of its stake), and about half of purchases come from OCP group companies, a shareholder.
Working capital: FY26 operating cash flow was −₹1,012 cr; every price spike swells inventory and subsidy receivables, which debt funds.
critiques.who: Analysts on the Q4FY26 call, GAM

gaps: No product or plant-level profit: manufactured vs traded EBITDA is given only as a range (~₹2,000/t trading vs ₹6,000-7,000/t integrated, plant visit).

Cost split of the ₹3,600 cr programme is from broker notes (PL: granulation ~₹700 cr, acid ~₹1,500 cr; Elara: ₹800 cr and ₹1,500 cr), not the company; timing guidance moved from end-FY28 to around Q2FY29-FY30.
No Jun-2026 balance sheet: only gross debt (₹6,500 cr) and subsidy outstanding (₹4,600 cr) from the call.
No dated consensus by 30-Sep-2026; Elara's post-Q1FY27 view was not found (its May-2026 note is known only from an aggregator summary).
An Antique Stock Broking initiation (Buy, ₹100) reported in the press could not be dated or opened; not used.
The Aug-2026 pledge release is from a secondary report of ZMPPL's filing, not the exchange filing itself.
Pre-merger history (FY19-FY24) is PPL alone; MCFL's own FY24 figures were not reviewed, so the FY24→FY25 growth is not like-for-like.
FY22-FY24 sales volumes were not compiled; volume history starts FY25 (restated).
